create_decoder: create a Decoder instance with custom handlers to decode key/data pairs from datapipes
build_imagehandler: build an ImageHandler with a specified imagespec to decode image bytes into numpy or torch tensors
test_basichandlers: test basichandlers to decode txt, json, pickle, and pt data by extension type
summarize_handle_extension: summarize handle_extension to create extension-matched decoder functions for custom file types
review_decoder_decode: review Decoder.decode to decode a list of key/data tuples using registered handlers
